_readme: Loaded map tiles (3dmap.gov.hk), extent in model coordinates [x0, x1, z0, z1] (x = Easting - 832250, z = -(Northing - 815900)). Everything on the map fades into the background over 'fade' metres at the outer edge of the union of these extents. When adding a tile to the model (tools/README.md), add its extent here; shared edges between tiles are detected automatically and never fade.
